why: Labels printed INSIDE the chapter's figures. PyMuPDF's text layer does not capture them — they are drawn as vector art — so a grounding probe reading only out/<id>.text.md reports every map-sourced fact as unsourced. This file is that missing text, read off the rendered page by eye and attributed to its figure, so the audit can tell 'the book says it, on a map' apart from 'invented'. Extend per chapter as map-referencing questions appear. Read the figure before adding a label here; do not copy from an answer.
